title: Twenty Charges
draft: Built 2026-10-18 from the 4.3 'Base Chain' stub's B4 with its defaults ('take the defaults and build 4.3d'): the Bangalore Palace grounds as base 4 (days 11–14), the engineer assembling the Pulse Gun overnight (20 charges; refilled only at a powered base — once the calibration is in), run 5 into Malleswaram (ground zero): Dr. Krishnamurthy's calibration drive and Vikram — patient zero, in his raincoat, at his PG. The Palace's lamp ring fails on its third night → Lalbagh (B5, next phase). The engineer is the HIVR courier from the airport (Act 0), named Sathish.
time: Act 4 day 11 07:00 → the morning of day 14
player_goal: At the Palace grounds: the engineer's gun, the fifth thing from Malleswaram, and a man in a yellow raincoat.
design_goal: The survivor becomes armed — barely: twenty charges, counted, and the first one most players will spend is on someone with a name. Malleswaram is the outbreak's first lane; Vikram is a person before he is a target. The camp finally looks like a camp.

cast.role: NEW (named). Sathish — the HIVR courier with the cold box at the airport (Act 0), now Rathore's engineer: builds the Pulse Gun overnight; refills it once he has the calibration.
Sends you to Malleswaram; after the dark night, Lalbagh.
NEW. Vikram, Deepa's shift partner, patient zero: in his yellow raincoat outside his PG, facing his own window. Release him (a charge) or leave him.

beats.what: The walk from the dead line at Cubbon to the Palace grounds: a ring of purple lamps on the lawn, tents, a truck, a generator, an engineer's bench under a tarp.
Sathish under the tarp: 'You saw me at the airport, didn't you. The cold box.' Give me tonight.
Morning: the Pulse Gun — twenty charges, one each; without the calibration it can't be refilled.
Run 5: Malleswaram, ground zero — three still at the west end; Dr. Krishnamurthy's study off the verandah: the calibration drive.
Vikram in his yellow raincoat outside his PG, facing his window. Raise the gun (a charge), or leave him.
Home at dusk; Sathish plugs the drive in: now the generator can refill the gun.
The third night the lamp ring fails (a card); Rathore: the glass house at Lalbagh.

economy.note: 20 to a gun; refilled by the engineer once calibrated

acceptance: the bot plays it from Cubbon to Rathore's decision
the gun fires, counts down and kills in the Playground
Vikram can be released or left
